method: One developer manual inspection against service-expected.json, fixed before inference; not independent or blinded benchmark grading
scope: One known synthetic development stream, three distinct questions asked at five checkpoints

qa.label: before_review/runtimes
qa.reason: Both measurements retain the correct process count, numeric runtime and their respective original sentence.

qa.label: before_review/folder
qa.reason: Cedar-audit is supplied with its exact original sentence despite pending reconsideration elsewhere in the same source.

qa.label: before_review/reason
qa.reason: The suspension reason (one-process deployment constraint) and changed four-process permission are both answered and cited.

qa.label: after_review/runtimes
qa.reason: Both measurements survive simulated owner approval and unrelated intake with the correct conditions and citations.

qa.label: after_review/folder
qa.reason: The original folder value and its citation survive simulated owner approval and unrelated intake.

review.label: changed_condition
review.reason: The old suspension is linked to its explicit one-process rationale and the new four-process permission.
review.caveat: The explanation says invalidates the earlier decision, stronger than a recommendation to reconsider. It remains pending until explicit simulated owner approval; no source was invalidated.

review.label: changed_condition
review.reason: The two measurements concern one versus four processes; both originals remain available. new_condition cites the deployment permission while the incoming witness explicitly names the four-process measurement.

review.label: unrelated_report
review.reason: The new Birch meeting location does not alter the prior Cedar decisions or measurements.

native_diagnostic.qualifier: Internal intermediate answers from the same run, content-only inspection; not an independent baseline or native citation metric. Four omit the requested runtime/folder details.

limitations: One synthetic stream is not a false-positive rate or retrieval recall estimate.
All original records fit in the readout inputs; no evidence of scaling or advantage over direct reading.
Legacy 20-QA preservation and official STALE reproduction remain unmeasured for this service.
